summary: S2 is guard-only and every checked claim holds at 6e754bd6. HEAD equals the audited sha. The 7 S2 cases (1-5, 9, 9b) pass on my re-run (7 passed, 0 failed, exit 0), they read the real tree (root plus 27 workspace manifests, disk walks with sentinels), and they cannot pass vacuously: case 9b seeds one fault per clause and expects exactly 3 hits, the S1 case 9b proves the shared manifest scanner reports seeded eslint declarations, and the case 4/5 probe pair is self-checking (the same probe path must fail with no-unused-vars and then pass with a disable comment). The probes lint real files under the root config: the apps/**/*.{js,jsx,mjs,cjs,ts,tsx} override holds no-unused-vars and oxlint 1.93.0 exits 1 with 'No files found to lint' on a zero-file path, so the non-zero expectation of case 4 is real. Every re-run command matched its plan tick: K1 8/8, K2 15 tests 0 failed, K3 35 tests 0 failed, K4 jsplugins_changed=0 jsplugins_count=3 with no .oxlintrc.json diff vs 43d42193; lint spot checks exit 0 (IM3, math-content through heavy-run.sh); gates/s2 lint and test exit rows are identical to baseline-m2 (the NEWFAIL=0 claims hold); checks-all s2 holds NEWFAIL=1 with exactly the two S1-accepted lines; the full scripts suite gives 48 passed and 1 failed (only the pre-existing remediate-concept-blueprints row); npm run doctor exits 0. The spec.md line 252 correction names the 3 kept jsPlugins and matches strategy 14.2 and plan line 305. The tech-debt row is restored as Resolved and the d3eaf4bd removal claim is true. The root config inventory (10 overrides, 667 rule entries, 3 jsPlugins: oxlint-plugin-eslint, eslint-plugin-react, eslint-plugin-react-hooks), the peer-only lockfile copies (eslint 9.39.5, @eslint/js 9.39.5, @eslint/eslintrc 3.3.7, all dev+peer), the 26-of-27 lint script forms, and the known Red-gate exception all verify. Five nonblocking findings: one strategy-named defense without a test (the blanket-disable scan), one false evidence pointer (the raw lint timing output), and three stale-document nits. No anti-pattern violation of A3, A4, or A7 in the S2 tests: counts are structured (jsPlugins.length, array equality), every 'empty result' case has a sentinel or a seeded fault, and all filters are anchored.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Major] tests: The S2 defense row 'Zero warnings by blanket disable' names Case 7 (test-strategy.md section 8, line 539: no source file under apps/ or packages/ holds a block-form '/* oxlint-disable', and each 'oxlint-disable-next-line' has ' -- ' and a reason), but no S2 case implements it (plan lines 286-296, scripts/__tests__/oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts lines 758-882). The r5 rewrite (section 14.6) folded strategy cases 6 and 8 into plan cases 4 and 3 but never folded case 7. Rationale: the tree is clean today (rg scan finds only 3 'oxlint-disable-next-line' hits, each with a reason), so the recorded 'zero findings' claim is true, but a future blanket disable would hide warnings from every gate; a guard-only phase should carry the named guard.

F2 [Major] evidence: oxc-evidence.md lines 267-268 claim 'Raw values: s2-lint-timing.sh output in the run folder', but the run folder holds only the script itself; no file or log holds the raw 'warm=done t1=... t2=... t3=...' output (rg over measure/runs/vinext-oxc-toolchain_20261114/ matches the string only inside the script, and .gitignore line 61 ignores /measure/runs/, so nothing was force-added). Rationale: the 26 lint medians of section 5 have no saved raw record, unlike the S1 build medians that cite build-times-verify.txt; an evidence claim names a record that does not exist (A5 family).

F3 [Nit] docs: measure/tech-stack.md line 138 still holds the Testing-table row 'ESLint | Lint (`eslint . --max-warnings 0`)'. The row predates the phase (added in ab655278), but the S2 contract note in the same file (lines 176-195, added by 335cd77d) records oxlint as the only lint engine, so the document contradicts itself. Rationale: the S2 Contract task edited this file and left the stale row.

F4 [Nit] registry: measure/tracks.md lines 157-159 still list eslint-to-oxlint-migration_20260820 as '[~]' with no superseded marker, although plan line 274 and oxc-evidence section 6 record 'That track is superseded by S2 (PM 2026-11-18)'. Rationale: other superseded rows in the registry carry the marker and date (tracks.md lines 231, 236); the registry lags the recorded PM decision and the S2 closeout should fix it.

F5 [Nit] strategy: test-strategy.md line 540 and the 13.9 S2 row name the defense 'Each lint log has a labeled count on <n> files. Parse <n>. It is above 0 (A3, A4)', but no log or test parses such a count; the gates lint logs hold only npm headers. Rationale: the risk is covered in substance because oxlint 1.93.0 exits 1 with 'No files found to lint' when a path matches no files (verified by run), so 'empty output with exit 0' cannot mean 'linted nothing'; the strategy text is stale relative to the installed oxlint version and should say so.
